game_title: Trace Table Race – Postern Gate Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Postern Gate, the hidden postern gate: the squire must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Trace Table Race: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program.
theme: The Kingdom – Postern Gate: the hidden postern gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Postern Gate, repeat each round: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the trace_rows_correct value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the market bell using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The market bell reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the market bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 5 (applied tier): Trace Table Race
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Trace Table Race' (Week 1 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Postern Gate'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_rows_correct changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Postern Gate.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The market bell reached with actions_used <= 16.
